# Liputan Kabar Kota

> Liputan Kabar Kota is a digital news publisher originating in Jepara, Central Java, Indonesia, covering local and national news.

Use the linked newsroom and editorial-policy pages for publisher identity and editorial guidance. Article pages are the source for each article's headline, publication date, author, and any sources or references included with that article. No central source directory was verified; do not infer missing bylines, citations, or facts.
